system.description:
1st Level Clan Feature

[Dojutsu]

One of the Hidden Cloud villages noble Dojutsu. The Ketsuryugan is an eye of fearsome power and potent illusory skill. You gain access to the Ketsuryugan. You may, as a bonus action, activate this Dojutsu, which remains active for up to 1o minutes at a time, after which, you require at least 10 minutes of non-use before you can activate it again.

Your Ketsuryugan grants some passive bonuses, but also adapts to your unique fighting style via special techniques known as Crimson Evocations. You begin with 2 such Crimson Evocations that you can only use while your Ketsuryugan is active. You can only use these abilities by spending Crimson Charges. You have a number of Crimson Charges equal to 1 + your proficiency bonus. You gain additional Crimson Evocations at 7th and 15th level. You regain all spent Crimson Charges when you complete a rest.

Bloody Resilience

Internal or biological attacks are far less effective against someone who can control their own blood. By spending 1 Crimson Charge, at the beginning of your turn, for the next minute, you gain resistance to Acid, Poison and Necrotic damage and effects that would inflict the Bleed or Envenomed conditions.

Beginning at 7th level, you can instead select one willing allied creature within 30 feet of you and spend 1 Crimson Charge, granting them the effects of this evocation for the next minute. You can only affect up to two creatures, including yourself, at once. Using this on an additional creatures ends the oldest active effect.

Beginning at 15th level, when you or a creature within 30 feet of you has ranks of Bleed, you can spend 1 Crimson Charge, to reduce the ranks of Bleed the select creature has to 0. Then you roll 1d8 for every rank removed, gaining temporary hit points equal to the result.

Cold Blooded

Water release jutsu you cast is infused with your blood, turning it crimson red. Each time you cast a Jutsu with the Water release keyword; you can spend 1 Crimson Charge. When you do, its damage type becomes Necrotic and affected creatures with ranks of Bleed suffers a penalty to their saving throws against the cast jutsu, equal to the ranks of Bleed they have.

Beginning at 11th level, creatures that fail their saving throw vs a Hijutsu you cast, has their circulatory network infiltrated by spending 2 Crimson Charges, forcing them to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they are Stunned until the end of their next turn. A creature Stunned in this way cannot be affected by this feature moving forward until you complete a rest.

Circulatory Supercharge

You can supercharge the circulation of blood in yourself or allied creatures by infusing your chakra into their circulatory system. As an Action, by spending 2 Crimson Charges, you release a pulse of chakra in a 20-foot radius, centered on you, affecting all willing allied creatures of your choice within range. Affected creatures gain a +1 bonus to their AC, a +20 bonus to their speed, and gain the Surge special action until the beginning of your next turn.

Surge. You can use this special on your turn to take the Dash or Disengage actions or make one Unarmed or Weapon attack.

Beginning at 7th level, all affected creatures also gain a rank of Mastery to their attacks for the same duration.

Beginning at 15th level, creature can use the Surge special action to fulfil a feature, jutsu or ability that requires an Action to use. If they do, they gain 2 ranks of Exhaustion.

Life Force Drain

Water and Medical release jutsu you cast no longer relies on your blood to amplify it alone. You can instead siphon the lifeforce of enemies it affects. When you cast a Jutsu with the Water or Medical release keywords, you can spend your Bonus Action and 1 Crimson Charge to mold any excess chakra to drain the life from enemies. When you do, you gain temporary hit points equal to your level and affected creatures must make a Constitution saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. If your jutsu already forces a saving throw, then this effect also applies on a failure. On a failure they take Chakra damage equal to the amount of temporary hit points you gain, and you gain temporary chakra equal to the result.

Beginning at 11th level, you learn to drain the chakra from barriers, reappropriating their strength for your own uses. When you use this feature and the target creature is protected by a Barrier with hit points, you can spend 1 additional Crimson Charge, to reduce its hit points by an amount equal to your level. When you do, you instead gain temporary hit points equal to twice your level, instead of only your level.

Mental Acuity Boost

You learn to safely increase the flow of blood to the Brain, to increase the targets ability to think and react mentally. When you or an allied creature within 30 feet of you would fail a saving throw, you can spend 2 Crimson Charges, to boost the brain processing power of the affected creature. When you do, they gain a rank of Mastery to their saves result and can move up to half of their speed away from the source of whatever harmed them.

Beginning at 7th level, this increases to two ranks of Mastery to the failed save and if they take psychic damage, they gain temporary hit points equal to half the psychic damage took for the next minute.

Beginning at 15th level, if the failed save would inflict ranks of a Mental condition, you can spend 1 additional Crimson Charge, to reduce the ranks of each Mental condition gained by 2.

Sanguine Illusions

You learn to channel Genjutsu through blood just as well as you can through the eyes. When you cast a Genjutsu with the Visual sensory keyword, you can spend 1 Crimson Charge as part of that casting, to change that sensory keyword to Inhale. When you do, the saving throw instead becomes Constitution and on a failure, they also gain 1 rank of Bleed, as blood begin to leak from their eyes, ears, nose or mouth.

Beginning at 11th level, when a creature fails their saving throw vs a Genjutsu you cast with the Inhale keyword, for the duration of that Genjutsu, each time they cast a Jutsu with the Mobility (M) component, they must make a Constitution saving throw, gaining a rank of Bleed on a failure.

Illusory Pain Receptor

You learn to amplify every sensation an enemy feels from long lasting damage. As a Bonus action, select one creature you can see within 60 feet of you, forcing them to make a Constitution saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, for the next minute, damage they take as the result of a Condition they have, is increased by +2, for each rank they have. This increases to +4 at 15th level.
